text:
Lina Torres: quick thread: we should pin down how we store "profile lineage" (base profile -> patches -> resolved artifact). current configs duplicate a lot and it's killing diffs.
Samir Khan: agree. two orthogonal concerns: compact storage and full auditable history. we need both.
Lina Torres: proposal: store base profiles as canonical objects in profile_store, store patches as small proto diffs referencing base_id + patch_id, and materialize resolved profiles lazily into endpoint configs.
Jules M.: that sounds right. can we make patch diffs tiny? for head-specific int4 patches it's just a few integers + dtype switch. protobuf deltas are fine.
Samir Khan: example proto idea: `message Patch { string id = 1; repeated LayerChange changes = 2; }` where LayerChange = {int layer_idx; oneof change { string dtype; repeated int heads; } }
Lina Torres: runtime will need stable keys for caching. suggestion: key = sha256(base_id + sorted(patch_ids) + global_fingerprint) and emit `profile.fingerprint` as tag in traces.
Jules M.: addendum: metadata on patch must include `author`, `tenant_scope`, and `origin_ts` so audit tools can show who changed what.
Samir Khan: DB shape: profile_store (id, proto_blob, fingerprint, created_by, created_ts), patch_store (id, base_id, proto_delta_blob, tenant_id, applied_count). endpoint_config stores reference to resolved_key not blob.
Lina Torres: migration plan: compat parser accepts legacy flat fields and writes a converted base + maybe a patch (if per-customer tweak). run converter as background job and keep compat layer for 30 days.
infra-bot: migration-canary: converter job scheduled for canary at 1746666676 :gear:
Jules M.: telemetry: emit metric `quant.profile.resolve_time_ms` and counter `quant.profile.fallbacks_total`. also log an event when resolved_key != requested_key.
Samir Khan: security: ensure patches are tenant-scoped; private deployments must never pull public patches into tenant profile_store. add validator in API that rejects cross-tenant patch refs.
Lina Torres: UI: show merged view but allow viewing "raw lineage" that lists base -> patches -> resolved. show diff highlights inline.
Jules M.: tests: unit for proto delta apply/rollback, and a golden-endpoint e2e comparing outputs before/after migration for 200 golden prompts.
Samir Khan: action items: I'll draft proto + DB schema. Lina will sketch migration tool. Jules will add telemetry+alerts.
Lina Torres: thanks, closing. will post the short RFC addendum with links to proto and schema PRs.
